content.short: Pirate Nation is an on-chain RPG at the intersection of casual gaming, Web3, and shared ownership.
content.description: Pirate Nation is an on-chain RPG that blends casual gameplay with Web3 and shared ownership. The project treats blockchain as a tool to boost fun and creativity in games, not the other way around. Players own their characters and earned assets, unlocking new and rewarding possibilities. Because the games are decentralized and open-source, they run indefinitely, are remixable, and belong to the community.
